rationale: Price remains above the 5-minute VWAP and 9-EMA with only a minor pullback from the recent high, keeping the original bullish momentum thesis intact. The wide bid-ask spread and minimal time in position make exiting or flipping inefficient, as transaction costs would erode the modest unrealized gain without a corresponding breakdown in technical structure. Maintaining the position allows the trade to run toward the original take-profit target while monitoring for a break below the $27.70 invalidation level.
